compliance_decision:
1. Beneficial ownership risks should be assessed by identifying and verifying all levels of beneficial owners, especially when the legal person presents a heightened ML (Money Laundering), TF (Terrorist Financing) risk or is deemed high-risk based on section 21B of the FIC Act.
3. Explanation: According to PCC-59-Beneficial-ownership, when a legal person presents an increased ML/TF and PF risk (Privileged Financial Partner) or is considered high-risk under section 21B of the FIC Act, institutions are required to identify all beneficial owner levels. This includes controlling owners, effective managers, directors etc., without eliminating any level and may require verification even for ultimate one percent ownership interest holders (9.2 & 9.3).
4. Human review Required: Yes
